Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Table Lamp, 16"H, White and Blue Stripe
Colors: Green/White
Materials: ceramic
Hues of blue-crackle highlights upon the white ceramic base of this striking lamp lend a true artisanal flair that blends with a variety of styles and decor. 8.5"W x 8.5"D x 15.5"H White ceramic base with blue decoration; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This colorful ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
